text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! You're an expert at everything,
Maya.

text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Since you're so smart, I figured you
could help me
with my relationship
problems too!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... It's true that I am a mature,
grown-up woman, but I think
relationships are... a bit much
for me
right now.

text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to think that hard about
it! Just
think of it like a race.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...So when the time comes, you have to
take the
initiative! No holding back!

text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text: Oh, I think I see what you mean!

text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text:
That's exactly the push I needed!
Thanks,
Maya. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No problem! Races, love—I can handle

anything! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to a flash of inspiration, Mayano
Top Gun
has succeeded at giving
relationship advice.

text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text:
So you don't have to think that hard
about it! Just
put yourself in the shoes of
the person you're
interested in, right?

text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text: Is there someone you're interested in, Maya?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
W-well... I guess so, but... being so
grown-up and
supporting me all the
time, I dunno if I—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: This is too much! I can't do this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun ends up learning the

fundamentals of relationships from her
friend.
